Aisha (CSM): Heads up — QBR dry run Wednesday 10am PT. Need slide polish + exec asks. Deck link: https://redwood.app/s/yrQBR-draft :spiral_note_pad:

Jules (CSM Lead): Got it. I'll take exec summary and renewal ask slide. Can we tighten renewal risk bullets to 3?

Tom (Solutions Eng): I'll add the performance numbers and latency/cost callouts. Need final model+env table from eng by Tue EOD.

Marta (CS Ops): Putting together onboarding pulse metrics. ETA Tue noon. Will include active seats, success rate, time-to-first-inference.

Aisha (CSM): Can we include a short quote from customer ops? @Jules please confirm wording.

Tom (Solutions Eng): pinging @Jules — want me to put both 99p latency and median? or just median?

Jules (CSM Lead): Both. Median for day-to-day, 99p for execs. Keep numbers in one slide.

Marta (CS Ops): Tracking enablement gaps: product demos pending for 3 teams, lookup: FWD-2234. I'll attach a short enablement plan.

Aisha (CSM): Action items —
• Jules: Exec summary + renewal ask (owner) — due Tue 3pm PT
• Tom: Performance slide + model/env table — due Tue EOD
• Marta: Onboarding pulse + enablement plan — due Tue noon
• Aisha: Run dry run Wed 10am PT; collect stakeholder Qs — ongoing

Jules (CSM Lead): I'll also prep a 2-slide canary plan showing rollback criteria and fallback model variant.

Tom (Solutions Eng): Noted. For the model/env table, I'll add quant/latency, region, fallback option.

Marta (CS Ops): Also capturing feedback themes from enablement survey: prompt tuning need, SSO doc gaps, SLA clarity.

Aisha (CSM): @Marta can you add those themes as talking points and suggested mitigations? Good to show we're actionable.

Marta (CS Ops): Yep — will add mitigations: scheduled enablement, SSO doc rev, SLA one-pager.

Jules (CSM Lead): Small ask — can someone grab exec approval for the renewal ask language before Wed? @Aisha, any blockers?

Aisha (CSM): I'm looping in @Ravi (AE) — Ravi can you review renewal ask wording Mon morning? :pray:

Ravi (AE): Will do. I'll review Mon 9am PT and push any edits into the deck.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar event created — QBR dry run Wed 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC. Invite: #customer-success

Aisha (CSM): Thanks all. Next update here after Tue sync. :thumbsup:
